title: Briv App
tagline: A completely decentralized chatting application that focuses on the privacy and security of the users.
description: This app is a decentralized chat application that works on the basis of blockchain technology. A user in this can't be cloned by another one as the account is tied to the unique id of the meta mask wallet. This app was created with privacy in mind and to protect from a single point of failure and also from single-point attack vectors.
how_its_made:
Connecting the wallet and writing the hardhat files.
Understanding the different protocols and concepts.
